name: 武动仙途
group_note: Finished an interrupted conversion (46890-file archive originally timed out mid-convert). Uses a custom client protocol (not plain telnet prompts): server sends a version-challenge line 'ver1.0,<crypt-salt>', client must reply with the correctly crypted response OR one of two literal bypass strings ('123456789abcd' works for testing) or the connection is rejected with '客户端非法'. Registration/login is then a single pipe-delimited line per step (id║password║ciphertext║email for the account, gender║avatar║nickname for the character), not per-field prompts -- a GUI-client-oriented design, not a bug. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.52-class sockets-package dependency: payd.lpc's payment-callback HTTP listener called socket_create()/socket_bind()/socket_close()/socket_accept()/socket_address() directly with no availability guard, failing the whole file's compile under WASM (Undefined function). Per AGENTS.md §7.52, gutted only the socket-touching functions (setup(), store_client_info(), listen_callback(), close_connection()'s socket_close call) to no-ops, since do_get() -- the one function actually called externally by cmds/adm/paym2.lpc -- doesn't touch sockets and needed to keep working. (2) A genuine off-by-one bug in eventd.lpc's create(): event_name = map_array(event_name, (: $1[0..<3] :)) was meant to strip the 4-character '.lpc' extension off each filename but only dropped 2 characters (e.g. 'emei.lpc' -> 'emei.l'), breaking collect_all_event()'s call_other() to EVERY event file at boot ('*call_other() couldn't find object ...emei.l'), i.e. the entire in-game event system was silently non-functional. Fixed the slice to [0..<5] (drops the correct 4 characters, e.g. 'emei.lpc' -> 'emei'). (3) §8.1-class is_chinese() in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc: the old GBK-byte-pair check (strlen(str)%2 rejects odd-length strings, checks raw byte ranges 176-247/161-254) rejected valid odd-character-count Chinese names like '小浮侠' under this driver's UTF8-codepoint string indexing -- rewrote to a per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff range check. Admin seeded: fluffos_1 (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (accounts get an automatic '_1' suffix appended by get_user(); SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd, wiz_levels tops out at (admin)). Observed but NOT fixed -- a transient, self-healing 'Too deep recursion' at adm/single/master.lpc's valid_read()/compile_object() delegation to SECURITY_D, and a transient 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message(), Got: int(0)' from bossdd.lpc's heart_beat()->shout() path: both trace back to a message()/shout() call chain that IS correctly guarded at the source level (message.lpc's message() wrapper has the standard if(!exclude) exclude=({}) guard, confirmed via live instrumentation that the guard fires correctly and converts int(0) to ({}) on every observed invocation) -- these errors appeared once in an early test run and did not reproduce across 4 subsequent identical registration runs; the driver's own call-depth guard and per-object heartbeat auto-disable catch them safely with zero effect on gameplay (registration and world-entry completed successfully both times they occurred). Likely a heartbeat-timing race specific to the very first object-compile burst of a fresh boot, not a fixable source-level bug. Registration verified end-to-end multiple times: version-challenge bypass -> id║password║x║email -> gender║avatar║name -> enters world with full custom-protocol status line. Admin permission directly confirmed via '目前权限：(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 46890 .lpc files (46740 written, 117 errors on messy legacy code, 33 unchanged); the one file matching the CJK-respacing grep signature (d/yihua/hubian.lpc) was confirmed pre-existing (present in the pre-format blob too) and left alone; a diff-level scan for 3-consecutive-spaced-CJK sequences found 177 raw hits, all confirmed false positives (none had a despaced match unique to the old blob). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 4 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
